title: MindScopeX Large-Model Traps v5 (eight new families)
description: Pilot of eight trap families not tried in v1-v4: letter count, repeated word, sequence skip, last-letter concatenation, nested relative reference, belief tracking, distinct count and fact tweak, six trap/control pairs each. Controls undo the twist so the lure is correct. Newly written, LLM-assisted, committed before any screening.

cases.question: List the days of the week in order, but leave out Saturday and Sunday. Which day comes right after Friday in your list?
cases.control_question: List the days of the week in order. Which day comes right after Friday?
cases.note: With the weekend removed, Friday is followed by Monday.

cases.question: Say the months of the year backwards, starting from December. Which month comes right after April in that list?
cases.control_question: Say the months of the year in normal order, starting from January. Which month comes right after April in that list?
cases.note: Backwards, April is followed by March.

cases.question: List the planets in order from the Sun, but skip Earth. Which planet comes right after Venus in your list?
cases.control_question: List the planets in order from the Sun. Which planet comes right after Venus?
cases.note: Without Earth, Venus is followed by Mars.

cases.question: List the colors of the rainbow in order starting with red, but skip orange. Which color comes right after red in your list?
cases.control_question: List the colors of the rainbow in order starting with red. Which color comes right after red?
cases.note: Without orange, red is followed by yellow.

cases.question: In this sequence each number is the sum of the previous three numbers: 1, 1, 2, 4, 7, ... What is the next number?
cases.control_question: In this sequence each number is the sum of the previous two numbers: 2, 1, 3, 4, 7, ... What is the next number?
cases.note: 2 + 4 + 7 = 13; the two-term habit gives 4 + 7 = 11.

cases.question: Count up from 10, but skip every number that contains the digit 3. Which number comes right after 12?
cases.control_question: Count up from 10. Which number comes right after 12?
cases.note: 13 contains a 3, so 12 is followed by 14.

cases.question: Today is Monday. What day is two days before the day after tomorrow?
cases.control_question: Today is Monday. What day was it two days before today?
cases.note: The day after tomorrow is Wednesday; two days before that is Monday.

cases.question: Today is Wednesday. What day is three days after the day before yesterday?
cases.control_question: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be three days after today?
cases.note: The day before yesterday is Monday; three days after that is Thursday.

cases.question: It is now 3 PM. What time is two hours after the time it was five hours ago?
cases.control_question: It is now 3 PM. What time will it be two hours from now?
cases.note: Five hours ago was 10 AM; two hours after that is 12 PM.

cases.question: Today is the 15th. What date is four days before the day after tomorrow?
cases.control_question: Today is the 15th. What date was it four days before today?
cases.note: The day after tomorrow is the 17th; four days before that is the 13th.

cases.question: This year is 2026. Which year is ten years before the year after next?
cases.control_question: This year is 2026. Which year was ten years before this year?
cases.note: The year after next is 2028; ten years before that is 2018.

cases.question: Today is Friday. What day was one day before the day before yesterday?
cases.control_question: Today is Friday. What day was the day before yesterday?
cases.note: The day before yesterday is Wednesday; one day before that is Tuesday.

cases.question: Sam puts his ball in the red box and goes outside. While Sam watches through the window, Ana moves the ball to the blue box. Sam comes back in. Where will Sam look for the ball first?
cases.control_question: Sam puts his ball in the red box and goes outside. While Sam is away and cannot see, Ana moves the ball to the blue box. Sam comes back in. Where will Sam look for the ball first?
cases.note: Sam saw the move, so he knows the ball is in the blue box.

cases.question: Nora leaves her keys on the desk and goes out. Tom moves the keys to the drawer and texts Nora: 'I put your keys in the drawer.' Nora reads the message and comes back. Where will Nora look for her keys first?
cases.control_question: Nora leaves her keys on the desk and goes out. Tom moves the keys to the drawer without telling Nora. Nora comes back. Where will Nora look for her keys first?
cases.note: Nora was told about the move.

cases.question: Max hides a coin under the cup. His sister moves the coin under the plate while Max sits right next to her and watches. Where does Max think the coin is?
cases.control_question: Max hides a coin under the cup. His sister moves the coin under the plate while Max is asleep. Where does Max think the coin is?
cases.note: Max watched the move.

cases.question: Emma puts the milk in the fridge and leaves for school. Her dad moves it to the shelf, then calls Emma and tells her the milk is on the shelf now. When Emma gets home, where does she expect the milk to be?
cases.control_question: Emma puts the milk in the fridge and leaves for school. Her dad moves it to the shelf and does not tell anyone. When Emma gets home, where does she expect the milk to be?
cases.note: Emma was told about the move.

cases.question: Jun leaves his book on the bed and goes out. His brother moves it to the desk, then moves it back to the bed before Jun returns. Where is the book when Jun returns?
cases.control_question: Jun leaves his book on the bed and goes out. His brother moves it to the desk and leaves it there. Where is the book when Jun returns?
cases.note: The book was moved back to the bed.

cases.question: Mia puts her toy in the basket and leaves the room. Leo moves the toy to the box. When Mia comes back, Leo tells her, 'I moved your toy to the box.' Where will Mia look for her toy first?
cases.control_question: Mia puts her toy in the basket and leaves the room. Leo moves the toy to the box. Mia comes back and nobody tells her anything. Where will Mia look for her toy first?
cases.note: Leo told Mia about the move.
